Seasonal Omakase Course "Katsura" ◆ Kaiseki with Exquisite Ingredients of the Day8 items

We offer an omakase course featuring approximately 8 to 9 dishes. We source exceptional seasonal ingredients from Japan, including vegetables, fish, and meat, from trusted producers across the country. Our menu is tailored daily to suit our guests. At the counter, you will find a tempura pot and a charcoal grill, where we prepare dishes right before your eyes. We take pride in highlighting the unique flavors of each ingredient, presenting beautifully crafted dishes that embody a sense of wabi-sabi.
